mentions.name: Inspec
mentions.description: Interior design software that replaces a single process in the interior design workflow, aiming to do that one job very well for professional designers instead of competing with full-scale project management suites.
mentions.problem: The interior design software market is split between amateur-focused 3D visualization tools, big clunky legacy tools for professionals that draw mild dislike to strong disdain, and newcomers trying to replace the old software entirely.
mentions.audience: Professional interior designers working on interior design projects
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm on the cusp of launching an interior design software I have built with my partner (she's the interior designer, I'm the coder).
